description: Parse browser user-agent strings into browser + version, engine (Blink, WebKit, Gecko, Trident, EdgeHTML, Presto), OS + version, device type (desktop, mobile, tablet, TV, console, bot, HTTP client), vendor and model. Recognises ~50 crawlers and AI bots (Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot…) and HTTP clients (curl, python-requests, Go, okhttp, Postman…). Give one "userAgent", a list, or a text/log file (one per line, or the last quoted field of each access-log line); up to 5000 per call, with a count by type. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/ua-parser/

accessLog.description: Read "file" as an access log: take the last quoted field of each line.

file.description: Or: a text file (path or base64) with one user agent per line, or an access log.

name: useragent_parse
title: User agent parse
